title: Amplitude-coherent strike-corridor knickpoint emission, relief-stratified, confined to off-catalogue state-map fault corridors
lane: tectonic geomorphology: bedrock-channel steepness (k_sn), knickpoints, chi transform; NOT scarp curvature
hypothesis: Quaternary-fault catalogue gaps are filled where the landscape still records a base-level step: knickpoints/steepness steps of the SAME SIGNED AMPLITUDE that align along one strike across >=3 independent drainages and persist over >=3 km mark active offsets that the USGS/INGENIOUS compilation omits. Restricting that evidence to corridors where an independent state-map (SGMC) fault is mapped but the Quaternary catalogue is silent concentrates mass on real structure that earns live credit, while relief-stratified emission removes the documented anti-relief bias of maximal-separation thinning.
mechanism: Differential rock uplift on the footwall of a range-bounding normal fault raises channel gradient upstream of the fault trace; the resulting knickpoint migrates upstream and, at the moment of sampling, drainages crossing the same structure show steps of comparable magnitude at comparable chi. Steps forced by lithology or by playa base level are not amplitude-coherent across independent drainages along one strike.
new_vs_every_prior_run: corridor evidence is AMPLITUDE-COHERENT (signed-polarity consistency x 1/CV of step magnitude) and STRIKE-PERSISTENT (>=3 consecutive 1 km along-strike bins), not a bare count of drainages in a corridor as in H60-A/H65-1/H66/H68
emission mass is allocated by RELIEF STRATUM (quintiles of 10 m-derived local relief over the footprint), the instrument repair the registry ranked #1 and never implemented
search domain is confined to >=100 m off the visible catalogue AND within 500 m of an SGMC trace that the catalogue does not contain (off-catalogue structure prior as a MASK, never as a ranking term)
emitted mass is chosen by a preregistered economics rule on the only live-anchored instrument, not by the catalogue flank

named_non_fault_mimic.process: lithologic control: a dipping resistant-over-weak contact crossed by several drainages produces aligned same-sign steepness steps without any fault
second_mimics: climate/orographic gradient (only partly removed by 40 km blockwise de-trending; PRISM not reachable from this sandbox, IR-66-CLIM-01 stands)
named_non_fault_mimic.mitigation: amplitude coherence + polarity consistency + strike persistence; SGMC-trace confinement (a lithologic contact is not mapped as a state-map fault); relief stratification

data.substrate: USGS 3DEP 1/3 arc-second (10 m) DEM reduced to the 100 m competition grid by the pinned dem10-chi GitHub workflow (18 tiles, public domain, sha256 in data/external/dem10_chi_100m.manifest.json); native 10 m tiles are NOT fetchable from this sandbox (egress allowlist), so the committed reduction is used unmodified

gates.P1_first_test: E1, the brief's mandated test, computed with the shared lane driver run_lane60.run_e1 (identical folds, seeds, 3 px buffer, 10 same-orientation transects per component, 40 km block de-trend, confound masks applied to both arms): PROCEED iff mean contrast > 0 AND 95% bootstrap CI lower bound > 0 over withheld components. Otherwise STOP.
gates.P2_leakage_canary: every feature alone, max(AUC,1-AUC) < 0.90 on the holdout, else treated as leakage and dropped
gates.P3_emission_economics: mass ladder 6k/12k/20k/30k/40k nested prefixes of ONE greedy relief-stratified order; select the LARGEST mass whose credit per dot on the population-matched off-catalogue instrument (SGMC traces >300 m from the catalogue, 61,664-62,226 px) is >= the champion H33-2-B2's own measured credit per dot on the same instrument (0.145568, measured in evidence/h71_artifact_comparison.json and re-measured here). If no arm clears the bar, verdict = negative.
gates.P4_uniqueness: max |Spearman| < 0.90 on the surface and < 0.90 on the field, and max fraction of MY dots within 3 px of another raster's dots <= 0.70, for every locally available registry raster; the two space-filling calibration lattices are reported separately as universal blockers together with the champion's own overlap against them (a gate no file in the family can pass).
gates.P5_format: shared validator: single band, float32, EPSG:32611, 3730x3292, transform identical to sample_submission, every stored cell finite and in [0,1] (zeros outside the footprint), zero positive pixels on the mapped catalogue.

reporting.holdout: the protocol's pooled hide-and-recover instrument (gems57-pooled-hide-v2, alpha 0.2, beta 0.8, 300 m triangular kernel, 8 cells, 20 km paired spatial-block bootstrap) is run and reported as HOLDOUT-DTI with the number of withheld positives and 95% CI, together with mass-matched random, ksn-only and distance-only controls. Its known inversion against off-catalogue emission (knowledge/03 section 4) is reported, not hidden.
reporting.no_score_claims: no number in this run is an organizer-confirmed score; the only organizer-confirmed quantities are public leaderboard rows
reporting.budget: 3 experiments / 2 hours; a weekly submission slot is an operator decision, promoted only by the separate selector step
